svg.title: The MaxManager design language: palette, type, spacing, radii and motion, taken from the app itself
svg.desc: One accent that follows the user theme, three warning colours that never do, three typefaces with one job each, a single 4dp spacing scale, five meaningful corner radii, and a motion budget whose ceiling is 360 milliseconds. Every value shown is read from the app token layer.

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
